text:
Jamie: Quick check-in  anyone up for a 'Cozy Cocoa Swap' + Ugly Sweater selfie table next Friday? Thinking light snacks, cocoa packets, and an ornament exchange. :hot_cocoa: :sweater:
Nora: Love it. Ill bring marshmallows and peppermint stirrers. :candy:
Diego: Ill bring a box of assorted tea bags for the non-cocoa crowd. Also down for the sweater thing 923
Tian: Can we do a charity spin? Folks can donate $5 for voting and proceeds go to the food bank. Keeps it fun and useful. :handshake:
Priya: Yes to charity voting. I can help collect money and set up a simple poll. I'll add a Venmo link in the doc.
Samir: I'll coordinate a tiny craft table for people to make desk ornaments to take home. Need a glue gun and scissors volunteers?
Maya: I can bring glue guns and extra glitter (no promises about clean desks afterwards). :sparkles:
Jamie: Sign-up sheet here: https://tinyurl.com/rw-cozy-swap  add what you're bringing and whether it's drop-off or staying. Also please note dietary restrictions.
Nora: Heads-up: one of our team members is allergic to tree nuts. Please tag snacks with N if they contain nuts.
Diego: Noted. I'll label my tea box (no nuts).
Tian: CalendarBot: Event "Cozy Cocoa Swap + Ugly Sweater Table" scheduled for 2023-12-22 11:30-12:30 in Main Kitchen.
Priya: Poll categories for selfies: Best Sweater, Most Cozy Setup, Best Pet Accessory (pets welcome in photos). Voting via Google Form, closes 5pm Friday. $5 per vote for charity, or free if you donate a wrapped toy.
Samir: I'll grab a donations box for toys. If anyone needs help shipping a toy from remote, DM me and Ill coordinate pickup.
Maya: Remote folks: we'll have a virtual room at 12:15 for a quick cheer and selfie parade. Also mailing labels for ornament swaps  put your address on the doc if you're OK with shipping.
Jamie: Thanks folks  this should be low-key and fun. If anyone wants to judge in person, volunteer here. Judges can't vote. :judge:
Nora: Volunteering as judge 44D
Diego: Me too.
Priya: I'll post the charity link and final rules in the doc by EOD Wednesday.
Jamie: Cool. Closing planning here  ping me if you want to add something. See you (and your questionable sweaters) next week! :party_popper:
